$comment: Tier-3 skill library. These repos are CLONED at install time, never vendored — some are huge.
Only the `tier2` skills below are linked into ~/.claude/skills and cost session context.
Everything else is indexed by build-index.mjs and pulled by path on demand.
Rejected repos are not cloned at all; each states why, so the decision is not re-litigated.

repos.name: web-animation-skills
repos.note: 9 skills, all promoted to Tier 2. Best-authored set in the collection: quoted-phrase triggers instead of bare topic keywords, so dispatch stays clean.

repos.name: claudedesignskills
repos.note: 22 individual plugins + 5 bundles. Only the 3D trio is promoted. Install NO bundles — they double-load skills that also exist as individuals, and drag in competing engines.
repos.caveat: Its advertised '27+ agents' are inert: agents/*.md start with '# Title', not YAML frontmatter, so Claude Code never registers them.

repos.name: animation-principles
repos.note: 144 skills = a strict 12x12 cross product (12 lenses x 12 principles). Content is genuinely good — 13,921 lines, zero duplicate bodies — but installing it costs ~5,900 tokens/session and every skill triggers on 'animation'. Consolidated into skills/visual-design-mastery/references/animation-principles.md instead. Pull 09-by-tool-framework/ and 12-by-problem-type/ by hand.

repos.name: design-extract
repos.note: 1 real skill plus a gallery of 23 indexed MEASURED design systems (cal.com, clerk, coinbase, duolingo, raycast...) as actual token files. The gallery is the value — real numbers, not prose.

repos.name: scroll-craft
repos.note: 1 skill, 7 tokens. Pull only when the deliverable is an entire scroll-driven site; gsap-web covers the technique.

repos.name: animate-skill
repos.note: Built on Emil Kowalski's 'Animations on the Web'. Sound easing model.
repos.caveat: Written against the pre-rename framer-motion API; current is `npm i motion` + `motion/react`. Its examples do not run as given (styles declared as unused template literals).

repos.name: css-animation-skill
repos.caveat: Its server-start steps assume POSIX (`lsof`, `python3`, trailing `&`) and fail on Windows.

repos.name: claude-design-skill
repos.note: Single skill; its references/design-styles.md and brand-context.md are the parts worth pulling.

repos.name: awesome-claude-design
repos.note: Not installable — a catalogue of 68 external DESIGN.md links (getdesign.md) describing real product design systems, indexed by industry. Reference material.

repos.name: pixel-plugin
repos.note: Keep for two engine-agnostic reference files: Bayer threshold matrices and Floyd-Steinberg error weights, which transfer directly to MonoGame and shader work.
repos.caveat: Do NOT install as a plugin. Its skills are a front-end for a paid Aseprite install; its launcher is an extensionless bash script with CRLF endings that cannot exec on Windows; and its triggers include bare 'create', 'make', 'draw', 'export', 'save', 'render'.

repos.name: claude-canvas
repos.note: Obsidian Advanced Canvas tooling — builds .canvas decks with 1200x675 group nodes. Useful only if you use Obsidian; not design/animation.

repos.name: open-design
repos.reason: Three independent grounds. (1) It vendors stale copies of 11 official Anthropic skills — brainstorming, canvas-design, frontend-design, pdf, pptx, theme-factory, web-artifacts-builder and more — which would SHADOW the real, current versions. (2) It is an Electron desktop app, not a skill pack: 232 of its 536 SKILL.md files are its own app's plugins and some are test fixtures. (3) Its README promotes DeepSeek, which is not an acceptable backbone here.

repos.name: browser-canvas
repos.reason: Requires local servers on ports 9847/3210/9224 to render anything. Its capability — previewing a live UI — is already native to Claude Code via the Browser pane and preview_start, so nothing is lost by excluding it.

repos.name: asd-ste100-skill
repos.note: Simplified Technical English (ASD-STE100) scoped to text a MACHINE parses without a human to resolve ambiguity: tool descriptions, error messages, inter-agent instructions, status reports. ~125 tokens resident. Directly relevant here — a skill description is English a model parses to decide dispatch, so this is the discipline that reduces trigger contention. Correctly refuses to reproduce the standard's copyrighted ~900-word dictionary from memory and points at the official free download instead.
